This '''national electoral calendar for 2022''' lists the national/[[Federation|federal]] elections held in 2022 in all [[List of sovereign states|sovereign states]] and their [[Dependent territory|dependent territories]]. [[By-election]]s are excluded, though national [[referendum]]s are included.{{Elections}}

==January==
* 16 January: [[Elections in Serbia|Serbia]], [[2022 Serbian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref>{{cite web|date=2021-11-30|title=Raspisan referendum o promeni Ustava Srbije - na glasanje 16. januara|url=https://www.bbc.com/serbian/lat/srbija-59480325|access-date=2021-11-30|website=BBC News na srpskom|language=sr|archive-date=2021-12-01|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211201104022/https://www.bbc.com/serbian/lat/srbija-59480325|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 19 January: [[Elections in Barbados|Barbados]], [[2022 Barbadian general election|House of Assembly]]<ref>{{cite news|date=28 December 2021|title=Elections called in Barbados for January 2022|url=https://barbados.loopnews.com/content/elections-called-barbados-january-2022|access-date=2021-12-27|website=Loop News|language=en|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211228022208/https://barbados.loopnews.com/content/elections-called-barbados-january-2022|archive-date=2021-12-28|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* 23 January: ''[[Elections in Northern Cyprus|Northern Cyprus]], [[2022 Northern Cypriot parliamentary election|Parliament]]''<ref>{{cite web|date=2022-01-22|title=Northern Cyprus will hold parliamentary elections|url=https://foreignbrief.com/daily-news/northern-cyprus-to-hold-parliamentary-elections/|access-date=2022-01-23|website=Foreign Brief|language=en-AU|archive-date=2022-01-23|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220123222518/https://foreignbrief.com/daily-news/northern-cyprus-to-hold-parliamentary-elections/|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 30 January: [[Elections in Portugal|Portugal]], [[2022 Portuguese legislative election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.cmjornal.pt/politica/detalhe/divorcio-da-esquerda-com-o-orcamento-empurra-pais-para-eleicoes|title=Divórcio à esquerda acelera eleições. Legislativas podem ser já em janeiro|work=[[Correio da Manhã (Portugal)|Correio da Manhã]]|date=26 October 2021|access-date=27 October 2021|language=pt|archive-date=27 October 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211027195700/https://www.cmjornal.pt/politica/detalhe/divorcio-da-esquerda-com-o-orcamento-empurra-pais-para-eleicoes|url-status=live}}</ref>

==February==
* 6 February: [[Elections in Costa Rica|Costa Rica]], [[2022 Costa Rican general election|President (1st round) and Parliament]]<ref name="Tico Times">{{cite web|date=2021-06-07|title=Ex-President Jose Maria Figueres Olsen Earns Nomination|url=https://ticotimes.net/2021/06/07/ex-president-jose-maria-figueres-olsen-earns-nomination-2|access-date=2021-06-07|website=ticotimes|language=en|archive-date=2021-08-05|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210805171516/https://ticotimes.net/2021/06/07/ex-president-jose-maria-figueres-olsen-earns-nomination-2|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 13 February: [[Voting in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2022 Swiss referendums#February referendums|Referendums]]<ref>{{cite web|author=The Federal Council|title=Popular initiative "Yes to the ban on animal and human experiments – Yes to research that brings safety and progress"|url=https://www.admin.ch/gov/en/start/dokumentation/abstimmungen/20220213/iniziativa-si-al-divieto-degli-esperimenti-sugli-animali-e-sugli-esseri-umani.html|access-date=2022-02-06|website=www.admin.ch|language=en|archive-date=2022-02-06|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220206200351/https://www.admin.ch/gov/en/start/dokumentation/abstimmungen/20220213/iniziativa-si-al-divieto-degli-esperimenti-sugli-animali-e-sugli-esseri-umani.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 27 February: [[Elections in Belarus|Belarus]], [[2022 Belarusian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref>{{cite news|date=20 January 2022|title=Lukashenka Sets February Vote On Amendments Further Consolidating His Power|publisher=[[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty|RFE/RL's Belarus Service]]|url=https://www.rferl.org/a/belarus-lukashenka-constitutional-amendments/31663697.html|access-date=21 January 2022|archive-date=21 January 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220121053433/https://www.rferl.org/a/belarus-lukashenka-constitutional-amendments/31663697.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

==March==
* 9 March: [[Elections in South Korea|South Korea]], [[2022 South Korean presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web|date=2021-06-28|title=Presidential Race Heats Up|url=https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/www/nation/2021/06/356_311249.html|website=koreatimes|language=en|access-date=2021-08-14|archive-date=2021-07-03|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210703155046/https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/www/nation/2021/06/356_311249.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 12 March:
** ''[[Elections in Abkhazia|Abkhazia]], [[2022 Abkhazian parliamentary election|Parliament (1st round)]]''<ref>{{cite web|date=2021-12-13|title=Parliamentary Vote Slated for March 12 in Occupied Abkhazia|url=https://civil.ge/archives/461767|access-date=2022-01-14|website=Civil.ge|language=en-US|archive-date=2022-01-13|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220113181314/https://civil.ge/archives/461767|url-status=live}}</ref>
** [[Elections in Turkmenistan|Turkmenistan]], [[2022 Turkmenistan presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Turkmenistan to hold early presidential election on March 12|url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/2/12/turkmenistan-to-hold-early-presidential-election-on-march-12|access-date=2022-02-12|website=www.aljazeera.com|language=en|archive-date=2022-02-12|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220212091919/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/2/12/turkmenistan-to-hold-early-presidential-election-on-march-12|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 13 March: [[Elections in Colombia|Colombia]], [[2022 Colombian parliamentary election|House of Representatives and Senate]]<ref>{{cite web|title=IFES Election Guide {{!}} Elections: Colombia House of Representatives 2022|url=https://www.electionguide.org/elections/id/3756/|access-date=2021-08-29|website=www.electionguide.org|archive-date=2021-11-26|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211126123310/https://www.electionguide.org/elections/id/3756/|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 19 March: [[Elections in East Timor|East Timor]], [[2022 East Timorese presidential election|President (1st round)]]<ref>{{cite web|date=2022-01-23|title=East Timor Nobel laureate Ramos-Horta to run for president again|url=https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20220123-east-timor-nobel-laureate-ramos-horta-to-run-for-president-again|access-date=2022-01-23|website=France 24|language=en|archive-date=2022-01-30|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220130000757/https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20220123-east-timor-nobel-laureate-ramos-horta-to-run-for-president-again|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 26 March:
** ''[[Elections in Abkhazia|Abkhazia]], [[2022 Abkhazian parliamentary election|Parliament (2nd round)]]''<ref>{{cite news |title=Supporters of authorities win parliamentary elections in Abkhazia |url=https://jam-news.net/supporters-of-authorities-win-parliamentary-elections-in-abkhazia/ |access-date=18 March 2022 |work=Jam News |date=13 March 2022 |archive-date=14 March 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220314132139/https://jam-news.net/supporters-of-authorities-win-parliamentary-elections-in-abkhazia/ |url-status=live }}</ref>
** [[Elections in Malta|Malta]], [[2022 Maltese general election|Parliament]]<ref>{{Cite news|last=Scicluna|first=Christopher|date=2022-02-20|title=Malta to hold parliamentary election on March 26|language=en|work=Reuters|location=[[Valletta]]|url=https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/malta-hold-parliamentary-election-march-26-2022-02-20/|access-date=2022-02-21|archive-date=2022-02-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220220125314/https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/malta-hold-parliamentary-election-march-26-2022-02-20/|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 27 March: [[Elections in Uruguay|Uruguay]], [[2022 Uruguayan Law of Urgent Consideration referendum|Referendum]]<ref>{{cite web|last=Nemitz|first=Ellen|title=The referendum to tackle Uruguay's rising crime|url=https://www.fairplanet.org/editors-pick/the-referendum-to-tackle-uruguays-rising-crime/|access-date=2022-02-25|website=FairPlanet.org|language=en|archive-date=2022-02-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220225065201/https://www.fairplanet.org/editors-pick/the-referendum-to-tackle-uruguays-rising-crime/|url-status=live}}</ref>

==April==
* 3 April:
** [[Elections in Costa Rica|Costa Rica]], [[2022 Costa Rican general election|President (2nd round)]]<ref>{{cite web |author=Staff writers |date=2022-02-07 |title=Costa Rica Presidential Election Heads To Second Round |url=https://ticotimes.net/2022/02/07/costa-rica-presidential-election-heads-to-second-round |access-date=2022-02-07 |website=The Tico Times |language=en-US |archive-date=2022-02-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220207154739/https://ticotimes.net/2022/02/07/costa-rica-presidential-election-heads-to-second-round |url-status=live }}</ref>
** [[Elections in Hungary|Hungary]], [[2022 Hungarian parliamentary election|Parliament]] and [[2022 Hungarian LGBTQ in education referendum|Referendum]]<ref>{{cite news|title=Hungary's general election set for April 3: President|url=https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/1/11/hungary-general-election-on-april-3-president|access-date=2022-01-11|website=www.aljazeera.com|language=en|archive-date=2022-01-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220111174142/https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/1/11/hungary-general-election-on-april-3-president|url-status=live}}</ref>
** [[Elections in Serbia|Serbia]], [[2022 Serbian general election|President and Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Izbori 3. aprila|url=https://www.b92.net/info/vesti/index.php?yyyy=2021&mm=09&dd=02&nav_category=11&nav_id=1916460|access-date=2021-09-02|website=B92.net| date=9 February 2021 |language=sr|archive-date=2021-11-26|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211126123439/https://www.b92.net/info/vesti/index.php?yyyy=2021&mm=09&dd=02&nav_category=11&nav_id=1916460|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 9 April: [[Elections in the Gambia|The Gambia]], [[2022 Gambian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|date=2022-01-19|title=Gambia: IEC Announces Date for Legislative Election|url=https://allafrica.com/stories/202201190141.html|access-date=2022-02-25|website=allAfrica.com|language=en|archive-date=2022-02-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220225181446/https://allafrica.com/stories/202201190141.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 10 April:
** [[Elections in France|France]], [[2022 French presidential election|President (1st round)]]<ref name=RFI-president>{{cite web|title=French presidential election to take place in April 2022|url=https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20210714-french-presidential-election-to-take-place-in-april-2022|date=2021-07-14|access-date=2021-07-23|archive-date=2021-07-23|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210723203928/https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20210714-french-presidential-election-to-take-place-in-april-2022|url-status=live}}</ref>
** [[Elections in Mexico|Mexico]], [[2022 Mexican presidential recall referendum|Referendum]]<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-04-08 |title=In unusual step, Mexico president asks voters if he should go |url=https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20220408-in-unusual-step-mexico-president-asks-voters-if-he-should-go |access-date=2022-04-13 |website=France 24 |language=en |archive-date=2022-04-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220413072518/https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20220408-in-unusual-step-mexico-president-asks-voters-if-he-should-go |url-status=live }}</ref>
** ''[[Elections in South Ossetia|South Ossetia]], [[2022 South Ossetian presidential election|President (1st round)]]''<ref>{{cite web |url=https://civil.ge/archives/469041 |title='Presidential Vote' Slated for April 10 in Tskhinvali Region |publisher=Civil.ge |date=2022-01-27 |accessdate=2022-03-16 |archive-date=2022-04-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220417151145/https://civil.ge/archives/469041 |url-status=live }}</ref>
* 19 April: [[Elections in East Timor|East Timor]], [[2022 East Timorese presidential election|President (2nd round)]]<ref>{{Cite news |last1=Da Cruz |first1=Nelson |last2=Lamb |first2=Kate |date=2022-03-20 |title=Ramos-Horta, Guterres early frontrunners in East Timor election |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/ramos-horta-guterres-early-frontrunners-east-timor-election-2022-03-20/ |work=Reuters |access-date=2022-04-13 |language=en |archive-date=2022-03-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220321004041/https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/ramos-horta-guterres-early-frontrunners-east-timor-election-2022-03-20/ |url-status=live }}</ref>
* 24 April:
** [[Elections in France|France]], [[2022 French presidential election|President (2nd round)]]<ref name=RFI-president/>
** [[Elections in Slovenia|Slovenia]], [[2022 Slovenian parliamentary election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web |last=Maček |first=Sebastijan |url=https://www.euractiv.com/section/politics/short_news/slovenias-president-offers-earliest-possible-election-date-to-ease-political-tensions/ |title=Slovenia's president offers earliest possible election date to ease political tensions |publisher=Euractiv.com |date=8 November 2021 |access-date=2021-11-26 |archive-date=2021-11-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211109171022/https://www.euractiv.com/section/politics/short_news/slovenias-president-offers-earliest-possible-election-date-to-ease-political-tensions/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

==May==
* 8 May: ''[[Elections in South Ossetia|South Ossetia]], [[2022 South Ossetian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]''<ref>{{Cite web |title=Runoff presidential election in South Ossetia to be held on May 8, CEC says |url=https://tass.com/world/1436701/amp |date=2022-04-12 |website=tass.com |access-date=2022-04-25}}</ref>
* 9 May: [[Elections in the Philippines|Philippines]], [[2022 Philippine presidential election|President]], [[2022 Philippine House of Representatives elections|House of Representatives]] and [[2022 Philippine Senate election|Senate]]<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.tobaccocontrollaws.org/files/live/Philippines/Philippines%20-%20Omnibus%20Election%20Code%20of%20the%20Philippines%20-%20national.pdf |title=Philippines Laws |access-date=2021-08-11 |archive-date=2021-10-11 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211011133757/https://www.tobaccocontrollaws.org/files/live/Philippines/Philippines%20-%20Omnibus%20Election%20Code%20of%20the%20Philippines%20-%20national.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref>
* 15 May:
** [[Elections in Lebanon|Lebanon]], [[2022 Lebanese general election|Parliament]]<ref>{{Cite news|last1=Azhari|first1=Timour|author2=Staff|date=2021-12-27|title=Lebanon sets May 15 election day for parliamentary polls|language=en|work=Reuters|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lebanon-election-idUSKBN2J60OI|access-date=2022-01-23|archive-date=2022-01-23|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220123184619/https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lebanon-election-idUSKBN2J60OI|url-status=live}}</ref>
** [[Voting in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2022 Swiss referendums#May referendums|Referendums]]<ref name="Bundeskanzlei">{{cite web|author=Bundeskanzlei BK|title=Politische Rechte|url=https://www.bk.admin.ch/bk/de/home/politische-rechte/pore-referenzseite.html|access-date=2022-02-06|website=www.bk.admin.ch|language=de|archive-date=2021-10-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211020030427/https://www.bk.admin.ch/bk/de/home/politische-rechte/pore-referenzseite.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
* 21 May: [[Elections in Australia|Australia]], [[2022 Australian federal election|House of Representatives and Senate]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Australian leader sets general election for May 21 |url=https://www.cnn.com/2022/04/10/australia/australia-elections-may-morrison-intl-hnk/index.html |date=2022-04-10 |website=CNN |access-date=2022-04-13 |language=en |archive-date=2022-04-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220413034131/https://www.cnn.com/2022/04/10/australia/australia-elections-may-morrison-intl-hnk/index.html |url-status=live }}</ref>
* 29 May: [[Elections in Colombia|Colombia]], [[2022 Colombian presidential election|President (1st round)]]<ref>{{cite web |last=rbalani |date=2021-07-02 |title=2022 Colombia Presidential Election |url=https://www.ndi.org/2022-colombia-presidential-election |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210829164209/https://www.ndi.org/2022-colombia-presidential-election |archive-date=2021-08-29 |access-date=2021-08-29 |website=www.ndi.org |language=en}}</ref>

==June==
* 1 June: [[Elections in Denmark|Denmark]], [[2022 Danish European Union opt-out referendum|Referendum]]<ref>{{Cite web |author=Staff and agencies |date=2022-03-06 |title=Denmark to hold referendum on scrapping EU defence opt-out |url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/mar/06/denmark-to-hold-referendum-eu-defence-opt-out |access-date=2022-05-15 |website=The Guardian |language=en}}</ref>
* 5 June: [[Elections in Kazakhstan|Kazakhstan]], [[2022 Kazakh constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Kazakh President Signs Decree For June 5 Referendum On Constitutional Changes |url=https://www.rferl.org/a/kazakhstan-referendum-constitution-changes/31836007.html |date=5 May 2022 |publisher=RFE/RL's Kazakh Service |access-date=5 May 2022}}</ref>
* 12 June:
** [[Elections in France|France]], [[2022 French legislative election|National Assembly (1st round)]]<ref>{{Cite news |date=2022-04-24 |title=French parliamentary elections – when do they happen and why are they important? |url=https://www.thelocal.fr/20220424/french-parliamentary-elections-when-do-they-happen-and-why-are-they-important/ |access-date=2022-05-15 |website=The Local France |language=en-US}}</ref>
** [[Elections in Italy|Italy]], [[2022 Italian referendum|Referendums]]<ref>[https://www.ansa.it/english/newswire/english_service/2022/03/31/local-elections-and-referendums-to-be-held-on-june-12-3_5ef94b4e-6418-46d9-a7ee-a739d572abf0.html Local elections and referendums to be held on June 12]</ref>
* 19 June:
** [[Elections in Colombia|Colombia]], [[2022 Colombian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]<ref>{{cite news |last=Schmidt |first=Samantha |title=In Colombia, two anti-establishment candidates head to a runoff |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2022/05/29/colombia-election-petro-gutierrez-hernandez/ |date=29 May 2022 |location=[[Bogotá]] |newspaper=[[The Washington Post]] |access-date=29 May 2022}}</ref>
** [[Elections in France|France]], [[2022 French legislative election|National Assembly (2nd round)]]<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-06-12 |title=French election: Macron's Ensemble edges close race in first round |url=https://www.euronews.com/2022/06/12/exit-polls-macron-s-ensemble-in-the-lead-after-french-parliamentary-election-first-round |access-date=2022-06-13 |website=euronews |language=en}}</ref>
* 22 June: ''[[Elections in Jersey|Jersey]], [[2022 Jersey general election|Parliament]]''<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-05-18 |title=Jersey Election 2022 candidates |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-jersey-61495337 |access-date=2022-06-30 |website=BBC News |language=en-GB}}</ref>
* 23 June: [[Elections in Grenada|Grenada]], [[2022 Grenadian general election|House of Representatives]]<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-05-15 |title=Prime Minister Mitchell announces June 23 election date for Grenada |url=https://barbadostoday.bb/2022/05/14/prime-minister-mitchell-announces-june-23-election-date-for-grenada/ |access-date=2022-05-15 |website=Barbados Today |language=en-US}}</ref>
* 26 June: [[Elections in Liechtenstein|Liechtenstein]], [[2022 Liechtenstein referendums#June referendum|Referendum]]<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20220707020508/https://abstimmung.li/franchisebefreiung-im-rentenalter/infos Franchisebefreiung im Rentenalter]</ref>{{citation needed|date=September 2022}}

==July==
* 4–22 July: [[Elections in Papua New Guinea|Papua New Guinea]], [[2022 Papua New Guinean general election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite news |title=Papua New Guinea voters head to the polls |url=https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/470275/papua-new-guinea-voters-head-to-the-polls |date=4 July 2022 |publisher=[[RNZ Pacific]] |access-date=3 July 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Vast improvement needed in election planning - Transparency PNG |url=https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/471479/vast-improvement-needed-in-election-planning-transparency-png |date=23 July 2022 |publisher=RNZ Pacific |access-date=23 July 2022}}</ref>
* 10 July:
** [[Elections in the Republic of the Congo|Republic of the Congo]], [[2022 Republic of the Congo parliamentary election|Parliament (1st round)]]<ref>{{cite news |date=7 May 2022 |title=Congo: First round of legislative elections set for July 10 |publisher=[[Africanews]] |agency=Agence France-Presse |url=https://www.africanews.com/2022/05/06/congo-first-round-of-legislative-elections-set-for-july-10/ |access-date=7 May 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Congo's legislative elections marred by low voter enthusiasm |url=https://www.africanews.com/2022/07/10/congos-legislative-elections-marred-by-low-voter-enthusiasm/ |date=10 July 2022 |publisher=Africanews |agency=Agence France-Presse |access-date=12 July 2022}}</ref>
** [[Elections in Japan|Japan]], [[2022 Japanese House of Councillors election|House of Councillors]]<ref>{{cite web|title=26th House of Councillors election|url=https://go2senkyo.com/sangiin/20368|access-date=27 November 2021|website=Election dot com|language=ja|archive-date=27 November 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211127083122/https://go2senkyo.com/sangiin/20368|url-status=live}}</ref><!--
The 2022 Indian presidential election is an indirect election. Please see the "indirect elections" section.-->
